read_time.docs: This [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#config-action) triggers a synchronization of the current system time from the RTC hardware.

duration.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The time duration for the timer.

*See also: [BM8563 Time Source](https://esphome.io/components/time/bm8563#bm8563start_timer-action)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the BM8563 component if you have multiple components.

*See also: [BM8563 Time Source](https://esphome.io/components/time/bm8563#bm8563start_timer-action)*

write_time.docs: This [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#config-action) triggers a synchronization of the current system time to the RTC hardware.

address.docs:
**int**: Manually specify the I²C address of the RTC. Defaults to `0x51`.

*See also: [BM8563 Time Source](https://esphome.io/components/time/bm8563#configuration-variables)*
